icons.name: 青莲剑歌
icons.subject: A graceful three-quarter view blooming blue-green lotus, its long central petal transforming into a bright slender Chinese sword pointing diagonally up-right. Five broad layered jade petals are clearly distinct, a short curved dark ink sword-energy sweep supports the bloom beneath. The LOTUS must be immediately recognizable, with one pale steel blade emerging above it. Dynamic but serene; restrained teal pigments and warm ivory sword glint.
